entities.name: Dalto
entities.description: Mercenary on Shandalar hired to bring back a chest holding the key to the Onakke Catacombs; touch-averse, silent.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who burst in to hire the mercenaries to break into the viceroy's palace.

entities.name: Harcu
entities.description: Mercenary who raised his sword to attack Liliana and was disintegrated.

entities.name: Onakke Catacombs
entities.description: Place whose key was in the chest.

events.summary: Liliana kicked the door down and proposed hiring the mercenaries to break into the viceroy's palace.
events.quote: Liliana Vess interrupted them by kicking the door down and barging in

events.summary: An angel disintegrated Harcu with golden light as he charged Liliana.
events.quote: the angel filled his body with golden light until he disintegrated

events.summary: The angel declared Dalto damned for all time and disintegrated him.
events.quote: The angel announced that Dalto was damned for all time

relations.quote: She planned to hire the mercenaries to break into the viceroy's palace.
